'''Goverdhan Mehta''' (born 26 June 1943) is an Indian researcher and scientist.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Keinan |first=Ehud |date=2023-03-31 |title=&quot;Scientific temper reflects the high values of science: truth seeking, objectivity and honesty&quot; - An interview with Prof. Goverdhan Mehta |journal=AsiaChem Magazine |volume=3 |pages=182–187 |doi=10.51167/acm00053|doi-access=free }}</ref> From 1998-2005 he was the director of the [[Indian Institute of Science]] (IISc). Previously from 1977-1998, Mehta was a professor of chemistry and vice-chancellor at the [[University of Hyderabad]]. Mehta has authored over 550 research papers.<ref name=":0" />

== Education ==
Mehta received his BSc and MSc from the [[BITS Pilani]]<ref name=":0" /><ref name="Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani) 2018">{{cite web | title=Prof. Goverdhan Mehta | website=Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani) | date=28 November 2018 | url=https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/GoverdhanMehtaDAA2011 | access-date=5 April 2021 | archive-date=25 July 2020 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200725111857/https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/GoverdhanMehtaDAA2011 | url-status=dead }}</ref> and PhD from [[Pune University]] in 1967.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize: an inspiration for international recognitions|journal=Current Science|date=25 July 2014|volume=107|issue=2|page=164|url=https://www.currentscience.ac.in/Volumes/107/02/0163.pdf|access-date=2015-07-28}}</ref> His post-doctoral research was at the [[Michigan State University]] under Prof. Don Farnum and at the [[Ohio State University]] under Prof. Paul G. Gassman.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://chemistry.uohyd.ac.in/gm.htm|access-date=2023-01-10|website=University of Hyderabad School of Chemistry|title=Goverdhan Mehta}}</ref> 

== Work ==
He joined IIT Kanpur in 1969 and remained there until 1977. From 1977 to 1998, he was Professor of Chemistry at the [[University of Hyderabad]] and from 1998 to 2010, he was a professor at the [[Indian Institute of Science]] Bangalore.<ref name="IISc 2003">{{cite web | title=INDIAN RESEARCH INFORMATION NETWORK SYSTEM | website=IISc | date=12 August 2003 | url=http://irins.inflibnet.ac.in/ | access-date=22 February 2022}}</ref> Since 2010, he is university distinguished professor and holds the Dr. Kallam Anji Reddy Chair at Department of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, India. From 2010-2018, Mehta was the Lilly-Jubilant Chair Professor at Department of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, India.

Mehta has authored more than 550 research papers. He is a recipient of over 40 honorary doctorates from India/abroad and has delivered over 300 invited/plenary/award lectures at Universities/Institutions across the world. He has been a member of the scientific advisory council to the prime minister and also the scientific advisory committee to the Cabinet.<ref name="SACC">{{cite web |url=http://psa.gov.in/uniquepages/singlepage_new.asp?ID=4| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070612040949/http://psa.gov.in/uniquepages/singlepage_new.asp?ID=4 | archive-date=12 June 2007 | title=:: Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India :: }}</ref>

== Academic and Professional positions ==
* Research associate, [[Michigan State]] and the [[Ohio State]] Universities, US,1967–1969
* Lecturer and assistant professor, [[Indian Institute of Technology]], Kanpur, 1969–1977
* Professor, [[University of Hyderabad]], Hyderabad 1977–1998, Founder Dean 1977–1986
* Honorary professor, [[Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research]], 1990–2009
* Visiting professor, [[University of Notre Dame]], Indiana, USA, Jun-1990 
* Srinivasa Ramanujan Research Professor, [[Indian National Science Academy]], 1992–1997
* Vice-chancellor, [[University of Hyderabad]], 1994–98
* Professor, Department of Organic Chemistry, [[Indian Institute of Science]], 1998–2005
* Director, [[Indian Institute of Science]], Bangalore, 1998–2005
* Tarrant Distinguished Professor, [[University of Florida, Gainesville]], USA, Jun-2002 
* CSIR Bhatnagar Fellow, [[Indian Institute of Science]], Bangalore, 2005–2010
* National Research Professor, 2009–2014
* Lilly-Jubilant Chair Professor, University of Hyderabad, 2010–2018
* Dr. Kallam Anji Reddy Chair, University of Hyderabad, 2018–

== Controversy ==
In 2006, the US Government refused Mehta a visa; this decision was strongly criticised by Indian and American scientists. The US ambassador to India David Mulford offered his apology to Mehta. 
<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2006/02/22/AR2006022202446.html |title=Scientist's Visa Denial Sparks Outrage in India |newspaper=The Washington Post |access-date=2014-05-17}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Mehta|first1=Goverdhan|title=Stereochemical Reassignment of Mehta and Kundu's Spiculoic Acid A Analogue|journal=Organic Letters|date=28 October 2006|volume=8|issue=24|pages=5537–40|doi=10.1021/ol062361a|pmid=17107066}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite web|last1=Curly|first1=Arrow|title=Spiculoic Acid|url=https://curlyarrow.blogspot.in/2006/11/spiculoic-acid-sort-of.html|website=curlyarrow.blogspot.in|access-date=2006-11-12|date=12 November 2006}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite web|last1=Totally|first1=Synthetic|title=Spiculoic Acid A Controversy|url=http://totallysynthetic.com/blog/?p=357|publisher=totallysynthetic.com|access-date=2006-11-15}}</ref>
<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nbcnews.com/id/wbna11522158|title=Scientific body denounces U.S. visa rules|website=NBC News|date=23 February 2006 }}</ref>
<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nbcnews.com/id/wbna11546142|website=[[NBC News]] |title=U.S. Issues visa and apology to scientist |date=24 February 2006 }}</ref>
